title: Panel Keyboard Navigation & ARIA Fix
description: Implement keyboard navigation (Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape/Enter) across intelligence panels and fix AccordionWrapper ARIA attributes from M4 debt
action: Fix AccordionWrapper.tsx first: add aria-expanded attribute to accordion triggers, add aria-controls linking trigger to panel content div, add id attributes to panel content divs matching aria-controls, add role='region' to accordion panel content areas. Then implement keyboard navigation for the panel container: use roving tabindex pattern where Tab moves focus between panels, Shift+Tab moves backward, Escape closes the currently focused panel, Enter/Space activates the panel's primary action. Add tabIndex={0} to each panel wrapper when it's the active panel in the roving sequence, tabIndex={-1} for inactive panels.

criteria: At least one intelligence panel file contains 'tabIndex'
At least one intelligence panel file contains 'onKeyDown'
convergence.verification: Run npx vitest run. Verify ARIA attributes in AccordionWrapper. Check keyboard event handlers in panels.
convergence.definition_of_done: AccordionWrapper has proper ARIA attributes, panels support Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape keyboard navigation

implementation: In AccordionWrapper.tsx: generate unique panelId using React.useId(): const panelId = `accordion-panel-${useId()}`
In AccordionWrapper.tsx trigger: add aria-expanded={isOpen}, aria-controls={panelId}
In AccordionWrapper.tsx content: add id={panelId}, role='region', aria-labelledby={triggerId}
For each intelligence panel: add tabIndex={isActive ? 0 : -1} to outermost wrapper div
For each intelligence panel: add onKeyDown handler that handles Tab (focus next panel), Shift+Tab (focus prev), Escape (close panel)
Use a shared hook or utility if the keyboard handler is identical across panels
Run: npx vitest run to verify no regressions

unit: AccordionWrapper renders with aria-expanded matching open state
AccordionWrapper trigger has aria-controls matching content id
Panel keyboard handler responds to Tab/Escape/Enter keys
